invented_facts: The comparison used one Vantage Pro 16 unit; the paper says three units of each configuration were tested.
Both Aurora 14 configurations achieved a median of 38 tokens per second on the 8B model; the paper reports that figure only for the base configuration.
notes: The summary omits test conditions, including room temperature, desk placement, power mode, and the 2,000-token prompt, as well as the absence of a Vantage battery test. It also exceeds the requested structure: six bullets appear in the summary, with no three key-message bullets following it.
